headline: Gandhi Special Tubes issues SEBI physical share transfer notice
summary: Gandhi Special Tubes has issued a notice regarding physical share transfers in compliance with SEBI guidelines. The filing serves as routine administrative communication for physical shareholders of the company. Indian retail investors holding physical shares must complete required documentation to dematerialize or transfer holdings. This procedural notice has no immediate bearing on the company's financial performance or stock price.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing for physical shareholders
